scope: Theorem 4.5 of the manuscript “A Conditional Reduction for Algebraic Kuga–Satake Correspondences” (preprints/A-Conditional-Reduction-for-Algebraic-Kuga-Satake-Correspondences-September-10-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e59953bdc640de5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Equation (4.1). Suppose that α ∈ CH2 (S × B)Q induces a nonzero map V → H2(B, Q) for some complex abelian variety B. Let ϵ1, ϵ2 ∈ {+, −}, and let A1, A2 be abelian varieties realizing Wϵ1 , Wϵ2 as their first rational cohomology. Every rational Hodge map β : V −→ Wϵ1 ⊗ Wϵ2 ⊂ H2 (A1 × A2, Q) is the restriction of the action of a cycle Γ ∈ CH2 (S × A1 × A2)Q. In particular, this recovers the full primitive Clifford multiplication tensor and its prescribed even-Clifford realization.
